shared_elements: low-relief carving covering the whole rock surface
possible schematic face or mask-like element
dense edge-to-edge composition without empty ground
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving with curving, looping lines that in places suggest a schematic face or eye-like motif, and in both the carving covers the available surface without blank ground. But A shows a legible, densely packed figural scene with standing anthropomorphs, headdresses, held objects and sign-like fillers stacked in registers, while B shows only broad, isolated curvilinear/spiral designs on rounded boulders with no discernible figures, attributes or relationships between them.
